I build payment systems and the tools around them. Twelve years in, I still measure before I change anything, and again after.

I started in warehouse software in Dundee, moved to card payments in Glasgow, and have worked for myself from Leith since 2021. Most of my work sits between a database and a person waiting for it.

Our Process

A Proven Process for Successful Delivery

Every project follows a clear, strategic process designed to reduce risk, accelerate delivery, and ensure measurable business outcomes.

Discover

We start by learning your business, users, and goals so every decision that follows is grounded in real data.

Strategize

We map the roadmap, tech stack, and priorities needed to hit your goals on time and on budget.

Design

We craft intuitive, on-brand interfaces that make complex products simple and enjoyable to use.

Develop & Deploy

We build, test, and ship production-ready software, then stay on to support and scale it after launch.

Why Choose Us

Built For Growth. Trusted For Results.

We combine innovation, engineering expertise, and agile delivery to help businesses scale with confidence.

Global Delivery Expertise

Serving businesses across regions with seamless communication, transparent collaboration, and on-time global delivery.

Agile & Scalable Solutions

Building flexible, future-proof technology designed to evolve with your business and scale effortlessly from startup to enterprise.

Trusted Technology Partner

FAQ

Frequently Asked Questions

What services does Algera Labs provide?

We offer software development, cloud solutions, AI integration, digital transformation, and dedicated development teams for businesses worldwide.

What industries do you work with?

We've delivered projects across fintech, healthcare, retail, logistics, and manufacturing, adapting our process and tooling to each industry's compliance and workflow needs.

Do you work with international clients?

Yes, we work with clients across North America, Europe, and Asia. We keep communication async-friendly and schedule calls to cover overlapping time zones.

How long does a typical project take?

Timelines vary by scope. A focused design sprint can wrap in a few weeks, while a full product build usually runs a few months. We'll give you a clear estimate after our first call.

Frequently asked Questions
What services do you offer?

There are many types of services we offer, ranging from design and development to marketing and consulting, but each project is tailored individually, ensuring a unique solution that fits your needs perfectly.

How long does a project take?

Project durations vary depending on complexity and requirements, but we always aim to deliver on time while maintaining quality, and we keep clients updated throughout the process to avoid surprises.

What is your pricing model?

Pricing can differ based on the project scope, complexity, and specific requirements, but we provide transparent quotes upfront so there are no hidden costs or unexpected charges along the way.

Do you offer post-project support?

After a project is completed, we provide ongoing support and maintenance to ensure everything functions smoothly, address any issues quickly, and help clients get the most out of the final product.
